name: ComPatch HC + GoB + E&F
short_description: E&F's stock and liquidity registration is a hand-written per-building whitelist. It predates Hail, Columbia! and Gates of the Bosphorus and never mentions the three privately-ownable buildings they add (fur trapper, hippo ranch, esparto plantation), so those three sit outside E&F's economy: no liquidity, no stock, no private ownership switching, and nothing in the error log. This wires all three into E&F's agricultural-stock mechanics, the same way E&F + Morgenroete already does for Morgenroete's 62 custom buildings. Load after all three mods.

tested_with.display_name: Hail, Columbia! - United States Flavor Pack
